rv.q: For all its warmth and musical exuberance, HADESTOWN never stops warning the audience where the story is headed.
It offers us the rare gift of seeing a story reborn in real time.
HADESTOWN is devastatingly hopeful in its exploration of love, resilience, and hope. It invigorates with its lively numbers and heart wrenching ballads.
Hadestown is a powerhouse musical that highlights the strength of the medium.
Ultimately, "Hadestown" becomes an offering for us—a song worth singing again and again.
It is simply a wild sensation onstage and collaborative theater at its very best.
Hadestown is truly one of those “once-in-a-generation” shows that sometimes doesn’t get the credit it deserves.
Musically, the show is in a class of its own.
HADESTOWN is a haunting and hopeful theatrical experience that grabs you and never lets go.
This show and this cast are truly excellent.
This was my first time to see "Hadestown" live on stage — and it was just literally breathtaking.
Hadestown, which opened last night at the Orpheum Theatre in Minneapolis, is a masterful work of art.
And it’s a splendidly entertaining musical that demonstrates why ancient myths deserve to be so enduring.
Anaïs Mitchell gets as close to such transcendence as any mere mortal might.
From the intricate production design of the show to the outstanding writing “Hadestown” is worth the watch and leaves audiences glad they took the trip down to Hadestown.
Every singer in the extended cast has a top-notch voice, and the live musicians on stage add personality and heart to the production, which feels very intimate and personal.
Hadestown brings something new to these ancient tales.
This is a great ensemble to see while they continue their tour.

Together, the cast and crew gave a showstopping performance, passionate enough to make even the hardest of hearts unharden and forcing audiences to look inward and grapple with what they would choose if they were in the characters’ shoes.
The musical's sublime score and compelling performances, led by a cast that infused every note with urgency, illuminated the fragility of hope in a world where survival often demands our soul.
If you see Hadestown you'll probably have a good time because the music, lyrics and book are great but not from the bland uninspired choices of this production.
It’s a spectacular production that, in my opinion, bested the original Broadway recording.

cn.t: Critics praise Hadestown's powerful retelling of Greek myth, with most hailing its spellbinding score, strong performances, and emotional resonance. A few find the touring production uneven, but the consensus celebrates it as a masterful, haunting work.
